about: Ready-made progression plans offered in More > Progression plans. Double progression: stay at a weight until your first sets hit setReps in order, then add weight (increment lb, 0 = auto: 2.5 under 30 lb, else 5) and restart at startReps. Two sessions in a row with a counted set under minReps lowers the weight by dropPct percent. The plan marked default is created on first launch. Rep ranges follow the ACSM progression models (1-6 reps strength, 6-12 muscle, 12+ endurance).

plans.name: Strength
plans.summary: 3 sets of 5 on heavy lifts, then add weight.
